nl: Rename the C# class OrderService to OrderBook, update its use in Program.cs and rename the file OrderService.cs to OrderBook.cs. Keep the CRLF line endings.

entries.content_utf8:
Microsoft Visual Studio Solution File, Format Version 12.00
Project("{FAE04EC0}") = "Orders", "src\Orders\Orders.csproj"

namespace Orders;

public sealed record Order(int Id, string Customer, decimal Amount);

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/Orders/OrderService.cs'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('public sealed class OrderService') == 1, 'src/Orders/OrderService.cs'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('public sealed class OrderService', 'public sealed class OrderBook').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('src/Orders/Program.cs'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('new OrderService()') == 1, 'src/Orders/Program.cs'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('new OrderService()', 'new OrderBook()').encode())
os.rename('src/Orders/OrderService.cs', 'src/Orders/OrderBook.cs')
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'src/Orders/OrderService.cs'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'public sealed class OrderService'; $n = 'public sealed class OrderBook'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in src/Orders/OrderService.cs' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'src/Orders/Program.cs'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'new OrderService()'; $n = 'new OrderBook()'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in src/Orders/Program.cs' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
Move-Item -LiteralPath 'src/Orders/OrderService.cs' -Destination 'src/Orders/OrderBook.cs'
